Off-topic response:

Ameena:

How does the Adept fly? I can't picture any of his songs which let him do that…which probably means I'm forgetting something really obvious ;).

His flight (and possibly his energy blasts, depending on whether they're actually energy damage or if they're Sonic) might actually be generated by him humming and controlling the sound waves to push him around in the air, a la the X-Man Banshee.

As to why he doesn't have a card for his flight…well, neither do Legacy or Fanatic.  The game doesn't have any element of tactical movement, so Flight isn't a terribly relevant power.  (If it were a bit less abstract about Environments, it could make a difference as to whether you have to worry about a Marsquake or the like, but as it stands there's no game effect.)  The minis game they've been talking about may be a different story in that regard, of course.
